facts.text: Request10 wordB comes from selected Gamecode; wordA is the current double-backed request counter cast to a word before the builder increments it. Byte fields are the UI+1484 and UI+1488 char-buffer/length pairs, in that order. Semantic names/encoding remain unverified.

Pre-submit helper queries a local profile condition and may show a confirmation dialog; no password transform was identified in this helper. New byte parsers do not produce or override a licensing decision.

Context creation passes cipher-selector flags1 and key-size argument8; callbacks and encrypted connection state are configured. Submit waits for write capacity, with an unbounded original loop. This work does not open sockets or imitate handshake readiness.

Registered receive parser consumes two-byte BE length plus complete body; types2/11 are parsed after the connection processing boundary. These are plaintext body/framing facts, not raw encrypted TCP equivalence.
Request1 body is tag1 plus two UInt32BE words, exactly9 bytes; business meaning retained as unknown.

Reply2 is tag2 and two UInt32BE words. Reply11 is tag11, two words, one counted byte field(cap32), counted byte list(cap64, each <=41 with native NUL in42B slot), five counted UInt32BE lists(cap64 each), and two final words. Unknown/trailing extensions are not interpreted.
Count encoding: <FD is inline; FD+u32be; FE+high32be+low32be; FF invalid. Reply container helpers require the high32 word to be0. Extended small counts are accepted by this reader.
Client hello contains BE32 major version1 and BE32 key length8; handshake state becomes1.

Challenge is resultBE32 then three BE32-length ASCII fields with maximum lengths62/1022/1022. Result0 path generates an exponent, calculates local public and shared values, copies leading derived key bytes, emits public hex lengthBE32 plus text, then sets native state999.

The two repeated base^exponent mod modulus operations implement DH-style arithmetic. Hex output is uppercase, whole-byte padded after stripping leading zero bytes, with0 represented as0. This is a static arithmetic derivation, not proof of authenticated peer identity or accepted group parameters.
facts.not_verified: Runtime acceptance, group validity and authenticated peer identity

facts.text: The shared hexadecimal text is converted from its leftmost byte pairs to both8-byte directional key buffers. Short text does not define a complete fill rule; the independent implementation rejects less than8 bytes rather than guessing.

Original exponent helper emits40 hex characters from a hash of process/time/tick/pseudorandom inputs. This generator is not copied. The new pure arithmetic API instead requires20 explicit bytes; future live adapters would require fresh CSPRNG material and separate verification.

Uncompressed send uses <=0x7fc8 plaintext bytes, zero padding to floor(n/8)*8+8, BE32 padded size and BE32 plaintext size, then Blowfish blocks using LE32 word I/O. P/S constants, key expansion and16-round Feistel/F operations match Blowfish.

Uncompressed receive reads two BE32 lengths, requires ciphertext<0x7ff9 and divisible by8, and plaintext<=ciphertext. LE32 block decryption emits exactly the declared prefix without stripping zeros or validating padding contents. The independent decoder separately requires ciphertext>=8.

After initial key scheduling the visible loops increment a raw key-buffer word but use already-built P/S schedules, which block operations only read. Independent codec reuses one unchanged schedule across records. Compression and other context modes are not implemented.
